notes.title: Playtest v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/8119bde6b6f726ea7be5114d8092e584bf8ca5cd.png"]Added a minimap UI to dungeons, and increased object density to make exploration more strategic and engaging.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/80e281b43537f5b15ba751d74ce4235cd729a849.png"]Enhanced interactions with Veronica, including new animations.



Other changes

Added various tutorials and guide texts.

Improved visibility of interactive objects.

Added progress display when sleeping.

Added new background art for dungeons.

Overall balancing adjustments.

notes.title: Playtest v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/04eb480270b7c884364c31d964137bd736f3574a.png
You can now see the cooldown of blessings at the top-left corner. Enjoy more strategic combat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/3e51b1e8f13b5b9e95e0396616b095efc2561a57.png
Talk to the parrot to receive various pieces of advice. But don’t expect it to speak endlessly.

Other Changes

 Dungeon balance has been improved.
 The tutorial area has been updated.

notes.title: Playtest v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/30354e46e908a8ce2e4717bc0ff708483cc19954.png
Monsters now burst with various fluids when hit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/1317381148adf4a4789ab4a36dab238a2dc3af84.png
The cathedral now glows gently under the moonlight during nighttime.


Other Changes

 Improved UI navigation for easier selection and cancellation
 Intro dialogue can now be skipped from the second playthrough onward
 Sword swings now connect more reliably with enemies
 Increased English text speed slightly
